stages.title: The Dark is Rising 1
stages.briefing:
1000 years ago, the Undead army disappeared with the defeat of the Dark Lord. However, the undead reappeared at the outside of the Capital Castle. People believed that It is a sign of the Dark Lord's return...

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Dark is Rising 2
stages.briefing:
Skeleton warriors keep attacking the Castle. The Hero must lead the warriors to defend the Castle.

Objectives:
Defend the base in 3:00

stages.title: The Dark is Rising 3
stages.briefing:
The last wave of undeads approached. Undead mages appeared with this wave. They are very powerful, can attack the soldiers in range. Hero must defeat them to keep the Castle in safety.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Expedition 1
stages.briefing:
Someone reported that some undeads were spotted at the Hopeless Swamps, so the King sent the Hero to find out the evidence of the Dark Lord's return. However, the Hero was ambushed by the undeads.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Expedition 2
stages.briefing:
The second wave of the undeads approached. The Hero must defeat them to breakthrough the ambush.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Expedition 3
stages.briefing:
The Dark Knight appeared and charged to the Hero. He must hold the defensive line and fight them back.

Objectives:
Defend the base in 3:00

stages.title: The Dark Forest 1
stages.briefing:
When the Hero enter the Dark Forest, a Tree suddenly fell down and blocked the road. At this moment, the undeads appeared and attack Hero.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Dark Forest 2
stages.briefing:
The Dark Knight performed Flank attack to attack Hero. If Hero cannot defeat them, he will be surrounded by the Undeads.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Dark Forest 3
stages.briefing:
Undead warlord led the undead troops to attack Hero. He can command the undead soldiers to perform special attack. Hero must defeat him to pass through the Dark Forest.

Objectives:
Destroy the undead base.

stages.title: The Hopeless Swamps 1
stages.briefing:
A Dark Castle was found in the Hopeless Swamp. There are some giant golems guarding the castle.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Hopeless Swamps 2
stages.briefing:
The numbers of Golems were more than expected. The Golems must be defeated in order to destroy the Dark Castle.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Hopeless Swamps 3
stages.briefing:
The Undead Warlord appeared in the Dark Castle and told Hero the Dark Lord was attacking the Capital Castle. Hero must defeat the Warlord as soon as possible.

Objectives:
Destroy the Dark Castle

stages.title: The Conspiracy 1
stages.briefing:
The Hero led his troops back to the Capital Castle immediately. However, the Dark Lord had already set a trap for the Hero.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: The Conspiracy 2
stages.briefing:
The skeleton dragons attacked Hero from the sky. Archers must be ready to shoot them down.

Objectives:
Defend the base in 3:00

stages.title: The Conspiracy 3
stages.briefing:
The Undead warlord are leading the Dark Knight to chase for the Hero. There is running out of time. Hero must defeat the warlord as soon as possible.

Objectives:
Destroy the undead base

stages.title: Dragon in the Dark Night 1
stages.briefing:
Hero's troop were assassinated one by one by Banshee. Hero must find out the enemies and prevent them from the assassination.

Objectives:
Defeat all enemies

stages.title: Dragon in the Dark Night 2
stages.briefing:
The Undead warlord become much stronger than before and leading the Banshee to attack Hero.

Objectives:
Destroy the undead base

stages.title: Dragon in the Dark Night 3
stages.briefing:
A giant undead dragon was awaiting for the Hero and his troops...

Objectives:
Defeat the Undead Dragon

stages.title: The Last Stand 1
stages.briefing:
The Dark Lord commanded all the undead armies to capture the Capital Castle. Finally, the Hero arrived on time. Could he defend the Castle?

Objectives:
Destroy the undead base

stages.title: The Last Stand 2
stages.briefing:
The Dark Lord summoned the Undead Dragon to the Castle...

Objectives:
Defeat the Undead Dragon

stages.title: The Last Stand 3
stages.briefing:
The Dark Lord launched a final attack to the Castle. Hero must win this battle. Otherwise, the Kingdom will fall. People will suffer from Terrors and Chaos again.

Objectives:
Destroy the Dark Lord's Castle

stages.title: Avatar of War
stages.briefing:
The Hero defeated the Dark Lord's undead army, but he found that the Dark Lord is immortal and cannot to be killed. The only way to stop him is to find the legendary weapon "Avatar of War" to seal the Dark Lord.

Objectives:
Stop the Avatar of War

stages.title: The Final Battle
stages.briefing:
The Dark Lord must be sealed with the "Avatar of War", so the Hero brought this legendary weapon to the Dark Castle and give the Dark Lord a final blow.

Objectives:
Destroy the Dark Lord's Castle with Avatar of War
